candidate_windows.window_text: Table 12 provides implementation and training details for each architecture. Same settings are used for training identical models types in different domains. We use standard fairseq $^{19}$ (Ott et al., 2019) implementations for all model types and train them on NVIDIA 1080ti or NVIDIA 2080ti GPUs. Model translations are obtained by averaging the final 5 model checkpoints and decoding using beam search with beam size 5.
